name: BAANKNET auction portal
purpose: Official bank auction search and bidder information
notes: User-provided auction records are snapshots; open the portal and current bank notice to confirm each property and deadline.

name: SBI auction notices
purpose: Official State Bank of India sale notices
notes: Check the individual sale notice for reserve price possession title and auction dates.

name: Union Bank auction property search
purpose: Official Union Bank auction property search
notes: The bank directs bidders to the current e-auction portal and notice.

name: Punjab National Bank e-auction notices
purpose: Official PNB immovable property auction notices
notes: Confirm details with the underlying bank notice.

name: Government of India eAuction India
purpose: Government e-auction portal hosted by National Informatics Centre
notes: General public-sector auctions; property availability varies by agency.

name: SBI home loans and plot-plus-construction
purpose: Official SBI home-loan rate and product page; ask SBI about plot purchase with construction
notes: Check current product availability, construction timelines, rate, fees, property criteria, and eligibility with SBI; auction finance is not assumed.

name: SBI home-loan terms and conditions
purpose: Official SBI home-loan terms document
notes: Check the current product version and confirm plot-plus-construction terms, property criteria, rates, and eligibility with SBI.

name: HDFC Bank home and plot loans
purpose: Official HDFC home-loan information including home purchase and plot-loan routes
notes: Check the current rate, fees, plot conditions, and applicant eligibility directly; terms can change.

name: ICICI Bank home loans
purpose: Official ICICI home-loan product information for buying or building a home
notes: Check current rate, fees, property criteria, and eligibility directly; terms can change.

name: ICICI Bank home-loan interest rates
purpose: Official interest-rate information page
notes: Use the bank page for current rates and validity; displayed rates and terms may change.

name: Axis Bank home loans
purpose: Official Axis home-loan product information
notes: Check current rate, fees, product fit, and eligibility directly; terms can change.

name: Canara Bank housing loans
purpose: Official Canara Bank housing-loan information covering purchase and construction routes
notes: Confirm current rates, fees, land/site conditions, and eligibility directly with the bank.

name: Indian Bank home loans
purpose: Official Indian Bank retail-loan information
notes: Check current home-loan product terms, rates, fees, and eligibility directly with the bank.

name: Union Bank residential plot loan
purpose: Official Union Bank plot-purchase product; page describes residential plot and approval conditions
notes: Check current layout approvals, project/property conditions, rates, fees, and eligibility with Union Bank.

name: PNB housing loan and composite plot-plus-house loan
purpose: Official PNB housing-loan options include purchase/construction and a composite residential plot-plus-construction route
notes: Confirm current plot/construction conditions, rates, margin, fees, property criteria, and eligibility directly with PNB.

name: LIC Housing Finance home and plot loans
purpose: Official housing-finance company page lists home, plot, construction, NRI, and pensioner loan options
notes: LIC Housing Finance is a housing-finance company, not a bank; check current rates, fees, conditions, and eligibility on its official site.

name: StepsStone verified project records
purpose: User-provided verified project workbook
notes: Project references do not establish that an individual plot or unit is currently available.

name: VGN official project directories
purpose: Official VGN directory pages used by the audited workbook
notes: Project references do not establish an individual unit is currently available; verify each field against its cited source.

name: Wisdom Properties official project pages
purpose: Official project pages listed in the workbook source register
notes: Workbook prices can be estimates based on comparables; verify project, price and availability with the linked official page.

name: CMDA 2024 layout planning permission register
purpose: Official planning permission register
notes: An approval record is not a current sale listing or proof of title or availability.

name: NoBroker listing extract
purpose: User-provided sale listing extract
notes: Snapshot only; seller authority ownership history and live availability are not independently verified.
